summary: Phase 6 of 8 only, per the dispatch's single-phase mission. Added 413 lines (zero deletions) to specs/evidence/seam-gluing-ray-product/hit-presented-model-a.lean, now 1220 lines: the run characterization, the one link the research left uncompiled. Eighteen new sorry-free declarations. Both pinned statements landed VERBATIM -- runTrace_mem_of_isRun (the subset direction) and exists_isRun_runTrace (the superset direction) -- confirmed by mechanical whitespace-normalized python string comparison against the plan's Lean Challenge Statements block, both MATCH; the advisory lean-challenge-snapshot.sh --check gate remains UNAVAILABLE for this task (exit 71, no manifest, never taken at plan time). The three excluded run shapes are each their own named theorem rather than prose, as the phase's third task asks: no_run_const_pre (no run is constant at a non-now state in either gadget, from IsRun's second clause alone), isLeft_const_of_isRun (Sum.isLeft of the run is constant along a step-chain, from Phase 5's stepOf_no_cross and nothing else, two-sided by Int.induction_on), and inr_no_back_edge (from a mid state the index strictly increases; j_post is the only reachable self-loop, so no mid-chain loop). Gadget confinement is exists_left_index/exists_right_index, built choice-free with Sum.elim. Gadget 1's rigidity landed as inl_bwd_pre, inl_fwd_post and inl_run_pinned. ONE HONEST FINDING, recorded in the probe's own section header rather than left implicit: because Phase 5 built labOf so that a gadget-1 state reads nothing but isNowState, the gadget-1 trace equality consumes ONLY IsRun's own now-clause, so those three pinning lemmas are NOT premises of runTrace_mem_of_isRun -- they are landed because the plan's route names them and because they are the record that no unclassified gadget-1 run exists. Nothing was dropped, weakened or substituted. inr_bwd_pre IS consumed, by inr_post_threshold's z <= t case. Gadget 2: inr_fwd_index proves every run reaches j_post within L+1 steps (at n = L+1 the mid-chain alternative IS j_post, since 1+(L+1) = L+2), inr_absorb/inr_absorb_add give absorption, and inr_post_threshold extracts the threshold w in [t, t+L] by Nat.find of the first forward index at j_post. The witnessing runs landed as named defs with their own evaluation lemmas: stayRun (+ val/now/isRun) and jumpRun (+ val/now/post/isRun); jumpRun's index is min(..., L+2) so the Fin (L+3) membership needs no side condition, and jumpRun_val proves the min is the identity on the intended range, so it is bookkeeping and not a truncation. The phase's branching scope claim is CONFIRMED and machine-checked rather than asserted in prose: inr_fwd_index plus inr_post_threshold plus exists_isRun_runTrace pin the realized thresholds to exactly Finset.Icc t (t+L), and jump_window_card proves that interval has L+1 members, with a computable #guard at L = 2 over stepOf's own edges into j_post (Finset.Icc on Int is not compilable, so the window is witnessed by the theorem). NO BOUND IS PRODUCED OR IMPLIED: the threshold comes from Nat.find and L remains the unexhibited Set.Finite.bddAbove witness of hitCl_eq_truncated, which jump_window_card's docstring states explicitly. Probe compile through the guard: guard exit 0, zero error:, zero warning:, zero sorries, both #guards passing. Axiom foot extended with two observed lines: runTrace_mem_of_isRun and exists_isRun_runTrace both [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], no sorryAx. Full project build re-run green through the guard (exit 0, 2836 jobs, zero error: and zero warning:) -- non-regression only, since the only modified file is under specs/ which no Lake target root reaches, so Tier 3 has no module to check this phase. COSTLY TOOLING TRAP, two compile rounds lost and recorded in the issue log: omega does not discharge an Iff goal in this toolchain -- every split_ifs <;> omega over '<index> = c <-> <time condition>' failed with a counterexample region equal to the hypothesis set; the fix is to decompose the Iff first (constructor <;> intro h <;> omega, or iff_of_false/iff_of_true with per-side by omega), and a paired trap is that split_ifs reduces a closed-literal branch like '0 = L + 2' to False, so that branch wants not_false. Diagnosed by reading the goal with lean_goal rather than by guessing.
